note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Adds a route(path:) query to load content by URL (entity/redirect/external). Distinctive per-bundle config key: entity_config.<type>.<bundle>.routes_enabled (only for types with a canonical link template). Medium/hard cases are grounded in entity_config.node.article.routes_enabled (baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_routes let a GraphQL client do, and what can a resolved route return?
evals.expected_output: It adds a route(path:) query to load content by URL; a resolved route can be an internal entity (RouteInternal), an external link (RouteExternal), or a redirect (RouteRedirect) - returned via a RouteUnion, and it can also return breadcrumbs.

evals.prompt: In graphql_compose_routes, which config key makes a bundle (e.g. node article) loadable through the route() query, and what must the entity type have for the option to appear?
evals.expected_output: entity_config.<type>.<bundle>.routes_enabled = true (e.g. entity_config.node.article.routes_enabled); the checkbox only appears for entity types that have a canonical link template.

evals.prompt: Which hook in graphql_compose_routes lets you rewrite an incoming URL path before it is resolved?
evals.expected_output: hook_graphql_compose_routes_incoming_alter(&$path, FieldContext $context) - modify $path (e.g. fix prefixes) before resolution. (There is also hook_graphql_compose_routes_union_alter for the RouteUnion.)

evals.prompt: On this site, one node bundle can be loaded by URL via GraphQL Compose routes. Inspect the config and name that node bundle.
Using graphql_compose_routes, make the Article node type loadable by URL through the route() query on the default GraphQL Compose server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
